data.description:
## Story

As a release engineer gating Phase 4 migration cutover on a multi-workflow coherence check, I can run a six-chunk multi-opus workflow coherence walkthrough that dispatches six independent opus-tier analyses across the brainstorm / preplanning / implementation-plan / sprint / commit-and-review / operational-dry-run surfaces, each producing structured JSON evidence and a PASS/AMBIGUOUS/FAIL verdict — so any FAIL/AMBIGUOUS finding blocks Phase 4 until resolved (spec amendment, prompt fix, or explicit defer decision).

This story re-implements epic a03c-d55e-1393-4f27 SC10 at the full scope specified in the epic. The existing `coherence-walk.sh` (a Phase 1 heuristic) is **not** the SC10 implementation — it is a deterministic regex-based scanner for transitional language and SC/CC overlap that runs in `validate.sh`. This story builds the multi-opus workflow walkthrough that SC10 actually specifies.

**Brainstorm prerequisite:** prompt design per chunk, dispatch coordination strategy, aggregated report schema, and the relationship to the existing Phase 1 heuristic (replace? augment? complement?) have substantial open design space. The `scrutiny:pending` tag enforces this.

## Done Definitions (verbatim from epic SC10)

- DD1 (six parallel chunks): The walkthrough dispatches six opus-tier analyses **in parallel** (single message with six Agent tool calls). Chunks:
  - **Chunk A (brainstorm)**: reads `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/brainstorm/` SKILL.md + phases/* + prompts/*; validates the brainstorm dialogue produces correct end-state-vs-Closure-Checks separation; verifies the new verifiable-sc-check rule is enforced; verifies approval gate output is well-formed.
  - **Chunk B (preplanning)**: reads `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/preplanning/` SKILL.md + prompts/* + docs/reviewers/*; validates story decomposition preserves the SC/Closure-Checks distinction at the story level; validates done-definitions inherit end-state-only semantics.
  - **Chunk C (implementation-plan)**: reads `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/implementation-plan/` SKILL.md + prompts/* + docs/reviewers/*; validates task decomposition produces AC + Closure Checks correctly.
  - **Chunk D (sprint)**: reads `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/sprint/` SKILL.md + prompts/* + the completion-verifier dispatch path; validates execution sub-agents consume the schema; verifies completion-verifier subtree walk integrates correctly with the sprint closure flow.
  - **Chunk E (commit-and-review)**: reads `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/docs/workflows/COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md` + REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md + all code-reviewer-*.md agents; validates review surfaces Closure Checks failures distinctly from end-state failures.
  - **Chunk F (operational-dry-run)**: runs `completion-verifier` in dry-run mode against the 10 most recently closed `brainstorm:complete`-tagged epics; per epic, records the count of items that would have been flagged as transitional under the new schema; documents as before/after evidence that the migration prevents future false-positive closures.

- DD2 (per-chunk JSON output): Each chunk produces structured JSON conforming to `{workflow_stage: "brainstorm" | "preplanning" | "implementation-plan" | "sprint" | "commit-and-review" | "operational-dry-run", status: "PASS" | "AMBIGUOUS" | "FAIL", evidence_citations: [{file: <path>, line: <int>}], findings: [{severity, description, recommendation}]}`. Schema documented in a contract doc at `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/docs/contracts/coherence-walkthrough-chunk-output.md`.

- DD3 (aggregated report): An aggregated report combining all six chunks is attached as a comment to the epic ticket being gated, in the format documented in the contract doc. Report includes a summary table (per-chunk verdict) + the full per-chunk JSON.

- DD4 (Phase 4 blocking gate): Any FAIL or AMBIGUOUS finding from any chunk blocks Phase 4 migration until resolved. Resolution paths: (a) spec amendment recorded as an Operational Constraints amendment comment on the epic; (b) prompt fix that addresses the underlying chunk failure; (c) explicit defer decision recorded as a comment. The gate re-runs after resolution and must report all-PASS to unblock.

- DD5 (relationship to Phase 1 heuristic): The walkthrough does NOT replace `coherence-walk.sh` (the Phase 1 heuristic). The heuristic runs in `validate.sh` on every change. The Phase 2 multi-opus walkthrough runs at Phase 4 gate time on the specific epic being migrated. Both gates must pass.

← Validates Closure Check: "the multi-opus coherence walkthrough is invokable, runs the six chunks in parallel, and emits the contracted JSON + aggregated-report comment"
← Satisfies: "SC10: Multi-opus-agent workflow coherence walk-through gated between Phase 3 (audit and pointer updates complete) and Phase 4 (migration). Six parallel chunks (A-F as specified), each opus-tier, each producing structured JSON {workflow_stage, status, evidence_citations, findings}. Aggregated report attached to ticket. Any FAIL or AMBIGUOUS finding blocks Phase 4 migration until resolved (spec amendment, prompt fix, or explicit defer decision)."

## Considerations

- **Brainstorming required before implementation-plan**: prompt design per chunk is non-trivial. Wrong prompts → false-positive AMBIGUOUS findings that block legitimate migrations; too-permissive prompts → false-negative PASS that misses real issues. Each chunk needs its own design pass.
- **Dispatch coordination**: six parallel Agent tool calls in a single message is the dispatch shape. Aggregation/error handling for one-of-six failing is open — does the walkthrough fail as a whole, or proceed with five PASS + one technical failure?
- **API cost**: six opus dispatches per epic at migration time. Acceptable cost ceiling at the configured `orchestration.max_agents` is reasonable, but document the per-run cost estimate.
- **Phase 1 heuristic interaction**: the Phase 1 heuristic catches simpler issues fast. The multi-opus walkthrough catches structural issues across workflow surfaces. They are complementary, not redundant. Document this clearly.
- **Operational-dry-run (Chunk F) data**: requires read access to the last 10 `brainstorm:complete`-tagged epics' compiled state. Confirm the verifier can run in dry-run mode without writing events.

## Brainstorm prerequisites

This story is tagged `scrutiny:pending` because the per-chunk prompt design and dispatch coordination have substantial design space. Run `/dso:brainstorm` before `/dso:implementation-plan`.

## Escalation Policy

Escalate when blocked — agents proceed unless a significant assumption is required that could send implementation in the wrong direction. All assumptions made without escalating are documented.
data.title: As a release engineer, a six-chunk multi-opus coherence walkthrough gates Phase 4 migration with per-chunk JSON evidence
